Definition: from G1853; to waken:--awake out of sleep.
BiblicalUsage: exypnízō is the word for awake out of sleep. In John 11:11, the text says "Our friend Lazarus sleepeth."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, exypnízō, I take at face value: awake out of sleep.
